title: Inspect and extend: Find projects in a local catalogue
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/Core.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve category data, search matching, sort ordering, and discovery rendering.
problem: Search and category controls narrow the sample catalogue. Follow the selected filter into the store/core and verify how the view receives the filtered projects. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/Core.swift` and the related project files: Sources/Core.swift; Sources/Screens/DiscoverView.swift; Tests/ProjectCoreTests.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to category data, search matching, sort ordering, and discovery rendering.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Search is local and only covers the included sample records.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Search and category controls narrow the sample catalogue. Follow the selected filter into the store/core and verify how the view receives the filtered projects.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/Core.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
